name: @farm/app-server
description: Microservices - each domain module runs as an independent NestJS HTTP server

scripts.build: nest build auth-service farm-service livestock-service poultry-service finance-service hr-service notification-service organization-service platform-service reporting-service crop-service realtime-service api-service
scripts.start:all: concurrently --names auth,farm,livestock,poultry,finance,hr,notif,org,platform,reporting,crop,realtime,api --kill-others "npm run start:auth" "npm run start:farm" "npm run start:livestock" "npm run start:poultry" "npm run start:finance" "npm run start:hr" "npm run start:notification" "npm run start:organization" "npm run start:platform" "npm run start:reporting" "npm run start:crop" "npm run start:realtime" "npm run start:api"
scripts.dev:all: concurrently --names auth,farm,livestock,poultry,finance,hr,notif,org,platform,reporting,crop,realtime,api --kill-others "nest start --watch auth-service" "nest start --watch farm-service" "nest start --watch livestock-service" "nest start --watch poultry-service" "nest start --watch finance-service" "nest start --watch hr-service" "nest start --watch notification-service" "nest start --watch organization-service" "nest start --watch platform-service" "nest start --watch reporting-service" "nest start --watch crop-service" "nest start --watch realtime-service" "nest start --watch api-service"
